text.2:45: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,
text.2:153: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.
text.2:250: And when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts they said: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.
text.7:126: Thou takest vengeance on us only forasmuch as we believed the tokens of our Lord when they came unto us. Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee).
text.12:18: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.
text.12:83: (And when they came unto their father and had spoken thus to him) he said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience! It may be that Allah will bring them all unto me. Lo! He, only He, is the Knower, the Wise.
text.16:127: Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad). Thine endurance is only by (the help of) Allah. Grieve not for them, and be not in distress because of that which they devise.
text.18:67: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.
text.18:72: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
text.18:75: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
text.18:78: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.
text.18:82: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.
text.70:5: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
text.90:17: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
text.103:3: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
